text: Choosing a processing model — batch, streaming, or hybrid, and the one requirement that decides it.
Streaming isn't just a better version of batch. It's fresher, but genuinely more complex — windowing, watermarks, and production practices exist because streaming makes things harder, not easier.
Hybrid runs a fast streaming path for freshness alongside a slower, thoroughly correct batch path for the historical record. That's not indecision — it's matching each requirement to the right tool.
Choosing streaming when batch would satisfy the requirement is needless cost for no real benefit. Next up: the lambda architecture — one standard shape a hybrid design takes.
